title: A High-Performance Minivan

scenes.headline: Fastest Minivan
scenes.narration: Zero to sixty in just 4.4 seconds—astonishing for a minivan.

scenes.headline: AMG 6.2L V8
scenes.narration: Under the hood, its hand-built 6.2-liter V8 engine churns out 465 lb-ft of torque, demonstrating AMG's bespoke craftsmanship.

scenes.headline: 4Matic AWD System
scenes.narration: The 7-speed automatic transmission paired with Mercedes' 4Matic AWD ensures excellent road handling and performance.

scenes.headline: $85K -> $65K (-4%/yr)
scenes.narration: Originally priced at around $85,000, this unique blend now trades for about $65,000—a yearly depreciation of around 4%.

scenes.headline: Price Point
scenes.narration: Rare in its segment, the R63 AMG stood apart with the AMG styling elements, including those aggressive alloy wheels.

scenes.headline: Luxurious Cabin
scenes.narration: Inside, it flaunts luxury with aluminum pedals and premium leather, combining comfort with AMG's distinct flair.
With its panoramic sunroof and adaptive air suspension, the R63 AMG enhances both driver and passenger enjoyment.

scenes.headline: Quad Exhaust Symbol
scenes.narration: The quad exhaust outlets serve as a hallmark of its AMG performance lineage, reflecting the vehicle's sporty emphasis.

scenes.headline: Final Question
scenes.narration: So, would you take a 503-horsepower minivan for your daily drive, or is that power best left on the track?

script: Zero to sixty in just 4.4 seconds—astonishing for a minivan. Under the hood, its hand-built 6.2-liter V8 engine churns out 465 lb-ft of torque, demonstrating AMG's bespoke craftsmanship. The 7-speed automatic transmission paired with Mercedes' 4Matic AWD ensures excellent road handling and performance. Originally priced at around $85,000, this unique blend now trades for about $65,000—a yearly depreciation of around 4%. Rare in its segment, the R63 AMG stood apart with the AMG styling elements, including those aggressive alloy wheels. Inside, it flaunts luxury with aluminum pedals and premium leather, combining comfort with AMG's distinct flair. With its panoramic sunroof and adaptive air suspension, the R63 AMG enhances both driver and passenger enjoyment. The quad exhaust outlets serve as a hallmark of its AMG performance lineage, reflecting the vehicle's sporty emphasis. So, would you take a 503-horsepower minivan for your daily drive, or is that power best left on the track?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2007 Mercedes-Benz R63 AMG, finished in Obsidian Black Metallic with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this R63’s past. According to the Monroney Label provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes Airmatic adaptive air suspension, a panoramic sunroof, third-row seats, Distronic adaptive cruise control, and a Harman/Kardon sound system. Notable modifications reported by the seller are limited to 20-inch AMG 5-spoke wheels. One of the more unexpected products of Mercedes-Benz's range expansion during the 2000s was the W251 R-Class. It was eloquently called a "Sports Tourer" by Mercedes-Benz, but was a minivan in every aspect other than its lack of the sliding rear doors common in its segment. The extremely rare R63 AMG model featured the powerful 6.2-liter V8 that propelled the vehicle to 60 miles per hour in approximately 4.4 seconds, making it the fastest production minivan in the world. Production began in the United States in 2006 and ended after the 2013 model year. Power comes from an M156 6.2-liter V8, rated at 503 horsepower and 465 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via a 7-speed automatic transmission and Mercedes-Benz's 4Matic permanent all-wheel drive system.
sections.Equipment: A Monroney Label is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes: Lighting Package (bi-xenon headlights with curve illumination, headlight washers, corner illuminating front foglamps) Airmatic adaptive air suspension system Panoramic sunroof Third-row seats Keyless Go Distronic adaptive cruise control Harman/Kardon sound system
sections.Seller Notes: The attached Carfax history report indicates an ownership change in March 2023. The seller reports that this is a clerical error, and they have filed a dispute claim with Carfax. The seller notes that the May 2025 service record erroneously indicates a mileage of 1,060 miles.
